pages.title: Operational States
pages.text: Alchemy furnaces, refinement forges, talisman tables and puppet core forges keep a server-side operational ledger: $(l)intact / damaged / critical / disabled$(). Efficiency multiplies soft-craft success for alchemy, refinement, talismans and puppets.

pages.title: Commission (form)
pages.text: Newly formed shells default to $(l)disabled$() until commissioned. Crafting at the station auto-forms when possible, or run $(code)/seeking_immortals station form <id>$(). Form reserves structure materials plus a shard tax and refunds on failure.

pages.title: Repair and Overhaul
pages.text: $(code)station repair$() spends spirit shards on already-commissioned stations and cannot bypass form. $(code)station overhaul$() spends structure materials (unresolved ids fall back to a capped price-band shard tax). $(code)station inspect$() reports state, HP and efficiency.

pages.title: Wear Loop
pages.text: Alchemy explosions, blown lids and failed brews wear the furnace (80/30/8). Incomplete shells also drift damage on inspect. Disabled stations reject soft craft. Keep stations intact to keep success rates honest.

pages.title: Common IDs
pages.text: Typical ids: alchemy_furnace_g1~g5, refinement_forge_g1~g3, talisman_table, puppet_core_forge, spirit_beast_evolution_pool. Build the shell, commission it, then craft.
